wish: viral internet-famous dancing kitten, cute meme cat dancing

brief.concept: Make the kitten unambiguously dancing: standing tall on hind legs with an exaggerated side-to-side hip sway and both paws pumping in the air.
brief.subject: dancing kitten silhouette
brief.wan_prompt: High-contrast 1bpp silhouette animation, pure white graphic figure of a chubby kitten against a total black void. The kitten stands fully upright on its hind legs, torso tall and vertical, both front paws thrust high and pumping alternately, hips swinging in wide exaggerated arcs side to side, tail whipping low in counter-rhythm. Round belly, big head, thick bold masses, no interior detail, crisp cut-paper edges. Motion is big and comedic: two counts left, two counts right, an obvious hop with feet leaving ground every fourth beat, ears flicking on the off-beat. Static camera, centered composition, flat shadow-play style, seamless loop.
brief.negative_prompt: color, gradients, texture, fur detail, gray tones, background scenery, floor line, text, watermark, realistic lighting, camera movement, multiple cats, thin wobbly lines, noisy edges, photographic style
brief.notes: iteration: director next_wan_prompt from previous review

review.subject_seen: a small upright kitten silhouette with ears, curled tail, and stubby arms raised in a dancing pose
review.summary: The kitten is instantly readable and cute, but it is small in the frame with timid paw gestures and thin limbs, so it reads as a pleasant icon rather than a bold, comedic dancing-meme silhouette I would sign.
review.next_intent: Make the kitten much larger in frame with a fatter belly, thicker limbs, and wildly exaggerated paw-pumping and hip-swing poses so the dance reads as big comedy even in a single still.
review.next_wan_prompt: High-contrast 1bpp silhouette animation, pure white graphic figure of a very chubby kitten filling most of the frame against a total black void. The kitten stands fully upright on hind legs, huge round belly and oversized head, short thick limbs, both front paws thrust straight overhead and pumping alternately with extreme energy, hips thrown far out side to side in wide comic arcs, tail whipping low in counter-rhythm. Motion is maximal and slapstick: two big counts left, two big counts right, a full airborne hop with feet clearly off the ground every fourth beat, ears flicking sharply on the off-beat. Bold thick masses, crisp cut-paper edges, no interior detail, flat shadow-play style, static camera, centered composition, seamless loop.
